RuntimeConfigDialog.Intro: Runtime configuration is stored in memory for the running process. Use this dialog for inspection and runtime-only updates.
RuntimeConfigDialog.MultiValueHelper: Separate values with commas, semicolons, or new lines.
RuntimeConfigDialog.NamespaceScopeHelper: Separate values with commas, semicolons, or new lines. Leave empty to allow all namespaces returned by kubectl.
RuntimeConfigDialog.AllowAllNamespacesWarning: Empty namespace scope allows operations against every namespace returned by kubectl. Restrict this list unless broad access is intentional.
RuntimeConfigDialog.SensitiveRestrictionsHelper: Separate values with commas, semicolons, or new lines. Only restart or scale targets whose names contain at least one keyword in this list. Leave empty to allow all names.
